seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Benicia, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Benicia, California for 2026: a First Street tree lighting, a holiday parade and market, and Pictures with Santa, checked.
lede: Benicia keeps its Christmas on historic First Street, with a tree lighting at the foot of the street, a holiday parade and market, and Santa at the fire station.
celebrates: Benicia Main Street and the First Street merchants open the season with a Holiday Open House and Tree Lighting at the historic train depot at 90 First Street, where hot chocolate and treats are served and the tree is lit at 6:30 pm in a ceremony presented by The Benicia Foundation. The same group produces the Holiday Parade and the Holiday Market on First Street. The City of Benicia's recreation department adds Pictures with Santa at Fire Station 11, with a toy drive and a private session for sensory sensitive children.
lastyear: Last year the Holiday Open House ran on Friday, December 5, 2025, from 6 to 9 pm with the tree lighting at 6:30 pm, according to Benicia Main Street. SolTrans ran free rides to the open house, according to its news page, and the Benicia Police Department posted downtown event and safety reminders ahead of the kickoff. Benicia Main Street's own promotion called the evening free holiday fun with live entertainment and music up and down First Street.
facts: Benicia Main Street's 2022 event page said the tree could be seen at about 6:30 pm at the foot of First Street while merchants offered seasonal beverages and treats, so the schedule has barely changed in years. The Holiday Parade is the 32nd annual and the Holiday Market is also numbered the 32nd annual. Benicia Ballet Theatre, based in the city, presents its 36th Nutcracker, though the performances are held in Fairfield at Solano Community College.
trains: Benicia's tree lighting starts at the historic train depot at 90 First Street, which Benicia Main Street names as the first stop of the evening. For real train rides at Christmas, the nearest option is the Western Railway Museum in Suisun City, which runs Santa Trains on December weekends and a Friday night pajama train, east of Benicia on the road toward Rio Vista.

kidfact: Benicia lights its tree at the foot of First Street, near the old train depot, and Santa visits a real fire station.
faq: Benicia Main Street lights the downtown tree at a Holiday Open House on First Street, adds a Holiday Parade and Holiday Market, and the city hosts Pictures with Santa at Fire Station 11. The Benicia Foundation presents the tree lighting, and Benicia Ballet Theatre stages a Nutcracker nearby in Fairfield.
When does downtown Benicia light its tree?

The Holiday Open House and Tree Lighting ran on the first Friday of December in 2025, and the tree was lit at 6:30 pm during a 6 to 9 pm evening. Benicia Main Street's older event pages describe the same 6:30 pm lighting at the foot of First Street.
Is there a quiet Santa visit in Benicia?

Yes. The City of Benicia's recreation department lists a private session for sensory sensitive children just before its general Pictures with Santa hours at Fire Station 11, and it says no RSVP is needed for that session. The general pictures are free, with a suggested new toy for the drive.
Where is the Benicia train depot?

Benicia Main Street names the historic train depot at 90 First Street as the starting point for the Holiday Open House, where free hot chocolate and treats are served. It is on First Street, the same downtown street that hosts the holiday parade and the holiday market.
Are there Christmas train rides near Benicia?

The Western Railway Museum in Suisun City runs Santa Trains on weekends in December and a Friday night pajama train, and its tickets are sold online. It sits on State Highway 12, east of Benicia, and the museum asks guests to arrive 45 minutes early.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Benicia for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (the Holiday Open House and Tree Lighting on First Street) through December 12 (the Benicia Holiday Parade and Market and Pictures with Santa at Fire Station 11). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Benicia

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Benicia
  • 2 free events: Pictures with Santa at Benicia Fire Station 11 and the Benicia Holiday Parade and Market
  • Meet Santa: Pictures with Santa at Fire Station 11 (December 12), with a sensory friendly session from 2:30 to 3 pm and a suggested new toy for the toy drive
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Holiday Open House and Tree Lighting (December 4) and the 32nd Annual Benicia Holiday Parade and Market (December 12)
  • Nearby: Benicia Ballet Theatre's Nutcracker is performed in Fairfield (December 12 and 13)
  • Season: December 4 to December 12
